subject_definitions:
  S1 (the red-robed pilgrim) = a tiny lone figure in a flowing scarlet-red robe with a long sash, seen from behind, mid-ascent on the lower center of the vast white jade staircase, occupying only a few percent of the frame height
  S01 (the heavenly stair world) = an endless stairway of white jade steps with carved balustrades climbing through a boundless sea of golden-cream clouds toward a towering dark-bronze heavenly gate at the top; colossal carved guardian deity statues flanking the stairs holding ornate staffs; a giant spiral galaxy vortex of gold-dusted stars and pale clouds crowning the deep starry blue sky above the gate; warm cream gold against deep starry blue palette, soft golden haze

summary:
[reference generation] Picture 1 is the reference that defines the entire world, art style, color palette, lighting and the figure's appearance. A single continuous 4.0-second shot: the camera performs one slow, buttery-smooth forward dolly with a subtle upward drift, gliding up the white jade stairway toward the towering heavenly gate, settling into a slightly closer framing with the gate and the galaxy vortex still centered above the stairs. The vortex's slow majestic rotation, the pilgrim's gently fluttering red fabric and drifting golden light motes provide all the environmental motion. The original painterly pigment art style, warm cream gold and deep starry blue palette and lighting remain fully unchanged throughout. One single uninterrupted take.

  S01 fully_preserved: white jade staircase with carved balustrades, the towering dark-bronze heavenly gate at the top, the colossal guardian statues in their exact flanking positions, the boundless sea of golden-cream clouds as static scenery, overall composition and perspective, overall painterly art style and palette

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] (0.0s - 4.0s, single continuous take)
0.0s-1.3s: the camera begins its slow forward glide up the stairway, the galaxy vortex rotating slowly and majestically about its own center like a great wheel of painted stars, its bands flowing steadily along their own curves while keeping exactly their original shape, golden light motes drifting through the haze
1.3s-2.6s: the glide continues at one constant unhurried pace, the heavenly gate and guardian statues growing gradually larger and more richly detailed, the pilgrim's red robe and long sash rippling gently in the high wind while the figure stays perfectly still on the steps
2.6s-4.0s: Final push: the camera settles into a slightly closer framing of the stairway leading up toward the gate with the rotating vortex still crowning the sky above, the red-robed pilgrim dwarfed at the center of the steps, the frame holds this composition to the end
Throughout this whole shot: the original art style, warm cream gold and deep starry blue palette, sunlight direction and lighting remain fully unchanged; the pilgrim stays perfectly still with only fabric moving; the vortex holds exactly its original spiral shape, width and position in the sky; every statue, balustrade and gate beam holds its carved form with the solid rigidity of stone; the camera follows one single constant path at a fixed gentle pace, gliding as smoothly as if floating on rails, one single uninterrupted take.

overall_soundscape: soft high-altitude wind moving over the stone stairs, the gentle snap of red fabric in the wind; ambient sounds only.
